# SereneDB

> SereneDB is a real-time search analytics database that unifies search and analytics behind a PostgreSQL-compatible frontend.

SereneDB combines full-text, vector, and hybrid search with SQL execution, columnar analytics, search indexes, remote tables, and durable RocksDB-backed updates. It is intended for workloads such as search-heavy analytics, AI knowledge bases, logging, internal tools, and product search.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://serenedb.com/): product overview, architecture summary, installation entry points, and community links.
- [About](https://serenedb.com/about): company and team information.
- [For Press](https://serenedb.com/press): press releases, logos, founder photos, and company boilerplate.
- [Download](https://serenedb.com/download): installation options, packages, Docker entry points, and GitHub releases.
- [Search Benchmark Game](https://serenedb.com/search-benchmark-game): interactive IResearch benchmark results and methodology links.

## Use Cases

- [All use cases](https://serenedb.com/use-cases): the eleven workloads SereneDB serves, grouped into search, analytics and data, and AI and agents, with the one engine they share and links to every use-case page.
- [Hybrid search database](https://serenedb.com/use-cases/hybrid-search-database): BM25 and vector search in one SQL query, filtered ANN, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, and a step-by-step build.
- [RAG database](https://serenedb.com/use-cases/rag-database): the retrieval layer for RAG, with text, vectors, and metadata in one index, hybrid retrieval, LangChain integration, and a step-by-step pipeline.
- [Search over a data lake](https://serenedb.com/use-cases/search-over-data-lake): full-text search over Parquet files in object storage, indexed in place through views over remote files, with a step-by-step S3 setup.
- [Documentation search](https://serenedb.com/use-cases/documentation-search): self-hosted docs search with Serene Docs Search over Git, folder, website, or S3 sources, in full-text, hybrid, or AI-answer mode.
- [Vector search database](https://serenedb.com/use-cases/vector-search-database): vector search in SQL with an IVF index, kNN and range queries, filtered ANN, embeddings from SQL, a step-by-step example, and when a dedicated vector database is the better choice.
- [Full-text search database](https://serenedb.com/use-cases/full-text-search-database): full-text search in SQL on an inverted index, analyzers and stemming, phrase, prefix and fuzzy queries, BM25 and the other scorers, search over files, a step-by-step example, and when a dedicated search engine is the better choice.
- [OLAP database](https://serenedb.com/use-cases/olap-database): what an OLAP database and a columnar database are, OLAP vs OLTP, how SereneDB runs analytical SQL (row groups, zonemaps, vectorized execution, GROUPING SETS, window functions, joins) beside full-text search, OLAP database examples, a step-by-step example, and when a distributed OLAP engine is the better pick.
- [Postgres full text search](https://serenedb.com/use-cases/postgres-full-text-search): native Postgres full text search and where it stops, BM25 and fuzzy search over the Postgres wire protocol, indexing tables of an existing Postgres, SearchBench against the Postgres family, and when native Postgres search is the better choice.
- [Real-time analytics database](https://serenedb.com/use-cases/real-time-analytics-database): rows queryable on commit and searchable after the next index refresh, ingestion over COPY and OpenTelemetry, search and GROUP BY in one SQL query, a step-by-step example, and when a streaming database or distributed OLAP is the better choice.
- [Zero-ETL search](https://serenedb.com/use-cases/zero-etl-search): zero ETL by federated query rather than replication, remote PostgreSQL and ClickHouse tables through CREATE SERVER, joins across them in one SQL statement, inverted indexes over remote rows refreshed with REINDEX, a step-by-step Postgres walkthrough, and the limitations.
- [Database for AI agents](https://serenedb.com/use-cases/database-for-ai-agents): one Postgres-compatible SQL endpoint for agent tools, with full-text, vector and hybrid search over native tables and remote sources, a login role per agent scoped with GRANT, a step-by-step setup, and what the docs do not cover.

## Technical Documentation

- [Getting started](https://serenedb.com/docs/quick-start): first-run instructions.
- [Installation](https://serenedb.com/docs/installation): Docker and Linux installation guides.
- [SQL reference](https://serenedb.com/docs/sql/introduction): first page of the SQL section, which covers statements, query syntax, functions, data types, and indexes.
- [Configuration](https://serenedb.com/docs/configuration/overview): configuration options, pragmas, limits, logging, and cloud credentials.
- [Search cookbook](https://serenedb.com/docs/cookbook/search): search recipes such as ranking, hybrid search, fuzzy search, facets, and highlighting.
- [Data import and export](https://serenedb.com/docs/data_import_and_export/overview): loading and writing CSV, JSON, and Parquet data.
- [Benchmarks documentation](https://serenedb.com/docs/benchmarks/search-benchmark-game): benchmark details and related analysis.
